title: Narrative is the most frequent visible breaking point for company-first hierarchy
description: Across experiments 007–009 the Narrative stage most often shows the first observable editorial shift away from the requested company-first introduction, turning upstream company positioning into an orchestration/product-led story. The angle explores why Narrative is the recurrent locus to target for correction or controlled testing.
audience: Product/content leads, prompt-engineering experiment designers, evaluation engineers working on Nuëyon.Compose workflows.
rationale: The report documents that Narrative is repeatedly the earliest visible stage that departs from the intended company-first hierarchy. Focusing a corrective trial or guardrails on Narrative is a targeted, evidence-supported intervention that avoids assuming Idea is always the origin. Communicating this helps prioritize experiments and evaluation instrumentation.
evidence: Facts from the source: “Narrative is the most recurrent first visible hierarchy shift in the available records.” The report lists Narrative as the first observable shift in multiple runs: Experiment 007 candidates 001–002; Experiment 008 A-002; Experiment 009 baseline 002/003 and candidates 001–003. Inference: because Narrative is repeatedly the first visible shift, testing or constraining Narrative is a reasonable next experimental locus. Unknown: whether Narrative is the root cause (it may inherit upstream priming from Idea or Synthesis) or merely the first stage where the divergence becomes observable.
